thread:
amanda: Quick sync — Evergreen Health case study draft is in. Need legal redline + customer quote sign-off. Customer asked that one internal metric be held back from public copy. Also need to route demo interest to Dinesh's AE queue after publish. Target publish: next Wed. Draft: https://docs.redwood/intern/cs/evergreen-draft

leo: On it. Where's the interview transcript? any embargo from the customer?

amanda: Transcript is appended to the doc (bottom). Embargo is off, but they asked we omit the ARR figure until legal confirms.

sylvie: Suggestion — if legal pushes back on the exact number we can use a moderated quote: "Evergreen saw meaningful adoption across core workflows" instead of raw metrics. Shorter and safer. :thinking_face:

legal: Reviewing now. Can you highlight the exact paragraph — I think it's paragraph 4 (around line 54). Also upload the signed release form if you have it.

amanda: Done — release form attached in the doc and paragraph 4 highlighted. The customer explicitly asked to avoid the 47% latency stat.

dinesh: Heads-up — once legal clears, please add a CTA that routes demo requests to demo@redwood.com and tags source=cs_post. We should also include a UTM for the publish vs webinar. I'll need leads routed to my AE workspace.

amanda: Will add CTA + UTM. Marketing ops to set assignment rule. Proposed rule snippet: `if source==cs_post && interest==demo then assign==dinesh_team`

sylvie: Also want to carve out a 30-min clip from the interview for the partner webinar. Customer windows: Tue 9–11am PT only. Can we lock one slot quickly?

leo: If webinar scheduling pushes, we can publish with a redacted quote and do a follow-up update after the webinar. Keeps launch date intact.

legal: Redlines done — pushed suggestions into the doc. Recommendation: replace the exact percent with phrasing like "high double-digit reduction in latency" and remove the ARR figure. Also added a short release clause we need the customer to initial.

amanda: Thanks — updating draft now and tagging the customer for sign-off. @dinesh after publish please verify lead flow for demo CTA. ETA publish 2024-03-27 10:00 PT. :rocket:
